name: Horizontal lanes (nether wart)
description: Nether wart on soul sand, two rows each side of the path, two stacked layers. No water is needed. SkyPilot reference layout derived from vanilla block-placement rules; it is not a copy of any community design. Check the Garden rules in-game before committing materials.
movement: Move to the next path (+Z by 5)
Drop to the lower layer when the top is done
harvest_direction: Along X, both sides of the path
water_notes: Nether wart does not need water.
